result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): A builds its mark on a single idea: a water drop cut by a ground line, with a well casing reaching down into it. It is shown in horizontal, stacked, reversed, one-color black, small-size (32/24/16px) and truck-door versions, which covers the rubric well. B's drop-and-bit badge with waves inside a circle feels more stock and gets busy at small sizes, and it shows no single-color version. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B's mark is a drop with a ground line cut through it and a drill pipe running down into the water. That reads as a well reaching the water table. It is shown at 32, 24 and 16 px, in one-color black and on a truck-door mockup, all of which hold up. A puts a fairly stock drop, a small bit and wave lines inside a generic circle badge. A only shows the small size at 36px, where the fine wave and bit details get lost, and it never shows a flat single-color version.
